paragraphs.dominant_move: says the higher education system is directly linked to the development potential of a country
says building a healthy and sustainable higher education system is of profound significance
says regarding this issue we mainly need to solve three problems in this paper
says in order to build a set of models that can be applied to assess the health in all countries
says we built our health assessment indicator system based on the system proposed by the OECD
says after determining the index system we use the entropy weight method to calculate the weights
says we determine the education power and the sustainability index to reflect the overall level and sustainability
says then we introduce the McKinsey matrix commonly used in management to measure the health
says we determine the classification range through the K-means clustering algorithm and divide the matrix into 9 boxes
says we use the coordinate and the distance d to reflect the health status
says we apply the model to some countries and select Italy where there is room for improvement
says we propose the vision of migrating the health state point from the current position to an upper right position
says specifically we will increase the score to 0.6 and make the index as close as possible to 0.41
says in order to realize this vision we put forward 5 policies and formulate a 12-year phased development plan
says for the non-intervention situation we use ARMA ARIMA and AR to predict the changes
says the results show that through policy intervention the development has achieved the expectations of our vision
says the distance between the health state point and the optimal point is 0.28 shorter
says finally we carry out a sensitivity analysis and an error analysis demonstrating the robustness and accuracy
says with the rapid growth of modern technology countries have laid great emphasis on their higher education development
says building a healthy sustainable higher education system is of profound significance for a country's long-term development
says in the context of the global pandemic many problems in the higher education system arise
says therefore it is critical to reflect on our higher education system and renew strategies to strengthen it
says considering the background in this paper we are required to solve the following problems
says since the middle and late 1980s education indicators have become hot topics in educational research all over the world
says a comprehensive education indicator system can help decision-makers learn about the real state and support future planning
says although there are already many indicator systems there is no system particularly built for higher education
says therefore it is necessary to build a model to measure and assess the health and give policy suggestions accordingly
says first of all we review relevant literature and choose the evaluation system based on CIPP as the reference
says secondly we apply our model to analyze the health state and select Italy as our evaluation object
says when we quantify the policy effects we take into account the interaction of indicators
says then we compare the results with the predicted scores in the absence of policies
says finally we analyze the impact of policies and point out the difficulties in improving the health

global_organization_chain: Define health as level plus balance before choosing any indicator
Adopt a named framework, state its two defects, and modify it
Settle an uncertain indicator direction by a failed overlap of rankings
Place countries on a grid and choose the one with a medium level and a low balance
Set one hard target and one soft target, then test both against an untouched forecast

main_argument_chains.claim: Italy's higher education has a middling level and a weak balance, and a twelve-year phased policy moves it 0.28 closer to the ideal than doing nothing, which itself gets worse.
support_steps: Split health into Education Power and a Sustainability Index, the output-input ratio
Weight twenty indicators by entropy within four dimensions and by AHP across them
Cut both axes by K-means and measure distance to (1,1)
Find the UK healthiest and Italy in the bottom middle box, and choose Italy
Set the vision at EP of 0.6 and SI as close as possible to 0.41, short of the best box
Forecast the untouched path with ARMA methods and the policy path with regressions
Show the untouched path deteriorating and the policy path ending 0.28 closer
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Raise spending, widen exchange, grant autonomy, promote enrolment and hire teachers, phased over twelve years, while conceding the capital may be unaffordable.
